statusMapping.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: OUT_OF_DOMAIN only when the last safe position lies on the ±40° latitude boundary (bisection tolerance 1e-6°); otherwise FORCING_UNAVAILABLE

rules.valid: true for ACTIVE/COMPLETED model positions, false for termination rows

definitions.observationMatching: exact UTC timestamp match with STEP 15 hourly QC files; no interpolation; missing → NOT_AVAILABLE
definitions.M1: 72 h endpoint displacement: release point → model position at t0+72h; NOT_AVAILABLE if not valid at t0+72h
definitions.M2: total trajectory displacement: sum of distances between consecutive valid=true output points up to the last valid point; valid duration (h) recorded
definitions.M3: observed-vs-modeled position error at every on-the-hour timestamp with an observation; horizons 24/48/72 h reported separately; NOT_AVAILABLE if model not valid or no observation
definitions.M4: alpha effect: RUN A vs RUN B position distance at timestamps where both valid; paired difference A−B of M3(72 h) when both available
definitions.M5: observed 72 h displacement (reference against cohort A2)
definitions.aggregation: per run, per run unit, overall (23): n, median, mean, min, max; paired metrics on the same drifter only
definitions.acceptanceThresholds: NONE in this protocol — trajectory production and descriptive statistics only; PASS/FAIL judgement requires a separate preregistration fixing STEP 12 K1–K5 numerically (validation-plan-v3)
definitions.independenceNote: temporal overlap within and across windows does not imply statistical independence; n=23 is not an independent sample count
definitions.confidenceIntervals: none for the deterministic model; no bootstrap at this step
